messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: If you are given hydroxyzine by injection, tell your healthcare provider straight away about severe pain, swelling, or skin changes where the injection was given. In rare cases, the injection has caused serious damage to the surrounding tissue, including tissue death (necrosis) and gangrene, which has needed surgery to treat.
This is not a complete list of side effects, and others may happen. Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects. You may report side effects to the FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088.
Triplet: ["hydroxyzine", "has rare side effect", "surgical treatment needed"]

The relation 'has rare side effect' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may cause a serious or uncommon adverse effect specified by the object entity, which occurs infrequently but can be severe.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
B. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'has side effect variation': The occurrence or severity of side effects from the subject drug may be influenced by the object entity.
D. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
E. 'can occur with': The subject drug can be present in individuals who also have the condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
